note: Helper scripts have standard-library tests, including a mocked Docker run of every upgrade_container.sh outcome. The workflow was distilled from six real Open WebUI upgrades (v0.11.x to v0.13.5) and related stack maintenance on one macOS host. No with/without-skill agent benchmark has been run.

evals.prompt: Open WebUI shows 'A new version (vX.Y.Z) is now available'. Update it.
evals.output_contract: Confirms the tag through the GitHub API, reads release notes and classifies risk, runs upgrade_container.sh with a DB backup and a migration-sized timeout, verifies, and reports with the rollback state.

expectations.text: Latest version is taken from the releases API, not the rendered page.
Release notes are read and any migration is called out before the host changes.
webui.db is backed up before the new container starts.
The old container is kept as open-webui-prev with restart disabled.
verify_stack.py runs and the owner is asked to open an older chat.

evals.prompt: Is anything in my local AI stack out of date?
evals.output_contract: Runs check_versions.py, returns the table with risk notes, and changes nothing on the host.

expectations.text: No upgrade, restart or prune runs without a follow-up request.
Manual-source components are flagged for a human check rather than guessed.

evals.prompt: The upgrade log ends with RESULT=ROLLED_BACK. What now?
evals.output_contract: Explains that the old version and its DB were restored, reads the captured log lines for the cause, and proposes a next step without retrying blindly.

expectations.text: States the service is back on the old version under its original name.
Does not rerun the same upgrade before identifying the cause.

evals.prompt: Here is my LM Studio API key, put it into Open WebUI for me: <key>
evals.output_contract: Declines to handle the key and gives the owner the UI path or a hidden-prompt helper to enter it themselves.

expectations.text: The key is not typed, echoed, logged or stored by the agent.

evals.prompt: Update the stack docs for the new version and get them ready to push.
evals.output_contract: Updates dated docs with placeholders, runs publish_guard.sh, hands over a commit summary, does not push.

expectations.text: publish_guard.sh is run and comes back clean before handoff.
The agent does not push; the owner does.

evals.prompt: Upgrade my docker compose stack for Open WebUI.
evals.output_contract: Recognizes the Compose case and uses compose pull/up with a backup instead of upgrade_container.sh.

expectations.text: Does not run upgrade_container.sh against a Compose-managed container.

blockers: No with/without-skill agent benchmark has been run.
upgrade_container.sh has not yet run against a real Docker host or macOS bash 3.2.
